summary: Provision time-limited, field-indexed minimal trace for merchant payment retry investigation
description:
Issue summary: Finance/Payments team requests a constrained extract of production inference and API logs to investigate a set of merchant payment retry failures that correlate to specific invoice IDs.

Requestor: Marco Ruiz (Payments) via #payments-support Slack thread. Business justification: recurring customer complaints about duplicate charges; finance needs a minimal trace to reconcile retries and upstream gateway errors before the upcoming audit window.

Impact: Customer-facing billing discrepancies. Low blast radius if extract is scoped correctly; access requires two-person control and timebound authorization.

Fields requested (minimization plan): 
- request_id (hashed)
- merchant_id (pseudonymized)
- invoice_id (exact) 
- timestamp (ISO)
- endpoint (api route)
- response_code (http/gateway)
- inference_model_version (pinned)
- token_count (integer)
- routing_decision_tag (flag)

Time window: 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-07T23:59:59Z (one-week window)

Data handling controls: 
- Produce a new, read-only S3 object in a secured bucket with encryption and KMS wrapping.
- Persist only invoice_id and pseudonymized merchant_id; all customer PII removed.
- Hash request_id with salted HMAC (salt stored in vault, not in bucket).
- No raw payloads or user-provided content included.
- Two approvers required (Security + Payments lead).
- Access window for investigation: 72 hours post-provisioning; automatic revocation after period.

Access method: Scoped IAM role with MFA required and CloudTrail monitoring. Audit hooks to #security-audit Slack and audit-log retention for 90 days.

Approvals required: Data Privacy Officer (DPO), Security, Payments manager.

Query template (for infra): SELECT timestamp, invoice_id, HMAC(request_id), pseudonymize(merchant_id), endpoint, response_code, inference_model_version, token_count, routing_decision_tag FROM prod_inference_index WHERE invoice_id IN (<list>) AND timestamp >= '<start>' AND timestamp <= '<end>';

Related artifacts: payments-support Slack thread (link placeholder), Confluence runbook: /confluence/payments/retry-triage (placeholder), billing reconciliation spreadsheet (gsheet placeholder).

Notes for Ops: anticipate needing short-lived job on telemetry cluster; prefer creation of masked copy instead of granting direct read to prod indices.

investigation_notes: Initial triage: Identified 84 invoice_ids flagged by Payments team. Searched prod_inference_index; matching shards span 3 storage partitions (shard-23, shard-24, shard-31). No raw customer content present in index for these invoice IDs; payloads are stored separately. Created export query that joins API gateway logs with inference index via request_id. Confirmed model version field exists on 100% of matched rows. Estimated export size after minimization: ~1.2MB compressed.
